companyProfile.title: Built on Four Decades of Manufacturing Experience.
paragraphs: Established in 1983, G.M. Consolidated is an appliance design, development and engineering manufacturer.
Over four decades of operational expertise have positioned the company as a manufacturing partner for small domestic appliances and personal-care electronics.
The company focuses on high-performance, export-quality products engineered to exceed industry baselines.
